title: Optional Items and Services: Terms of Supply under Ancillary and Optional Services Billing
content:
Optional items and services under Ancillary and Optional Services Billing are chargeable to any resident who asks for them, in every ancillary account tier.

## Optional item categories (every tier)

1. Beauty and barber
2. Telephone
3. Cable television
4. Guest meal
5. Dry cleaning
6. Non-medical transport
7. Premium incontinence brand

## Terms (every tier)

| Term | Setting |
|---|---|
| The price of an optional item is disclosed before it is supplied | Yes |
| An optional item is supplied only on the resident's or representative's request | Yes |

## Applying the terms

- A resident in Ancillary Account, Medical Assistance and a resident in Ancillary Account, Private Pay stand on the same footing for these seven categories: each is chargeable to the resident who asks for it.
- Both terms hold in every tier, so in no tier is an optional item supplied before its price has been disclosed, and in no tier is it supplied without the resident's or representative's request.
